provenance_note: Transcribed from the prior LMC-East campaign and source-follow-up reports. The underlying science arrays, full measurements and catalog receipts were not available during this repository update; these reported values have not been independently remeasured for this commit.

reported_source_followup.competing_sources_note: A nearby eclipsing binary is 11.55 arcsec away; a distinct Gaia source only 1.06 arcsec from the Cepheid was nearly as consistent with the TESS fits. Resolved photometry is still needed.
Source assignment favored by resolved two-band photometry; retained as a comparison case, not a newly discovered binary.

limitations: The external archive bytes and digests are not in this repository; no independently reproducible scientific release is claimed.
Individual-frame and half-day-block shuffles preserve different temporal correlations; their counts are not an estimate of the actual false-discovery fraction.
Injection recovery conditional on these fields, amplitudes and periods does not establish wide-area completeness.
A source within 1.06 arcsec of the proposed Cepheid counterpart remains unresolved.
